bg_facts: Anthropic launched Claude Sheets in beta on Nov 10.
Meetings puts Claude in your video call.
Sheets and Whiteboards are on paid plans.

slides.title: What *happened*
slides.body: On Tuesday, November 10, Anthropic launched Claude Sheets and Claude Whiteboards in beta, plus Claude Meetings, which puts Claude inside your video calls. It is a push into everyday office work, up against Microsoft and Google.

slides.title: Claude *Sheets*
slides.body: Describe the table you need, like a campaign tracker or a hiring budget. Claude sets it up with tabs, formulas, formatting and dropdown menus. Your team edits it with Claude, and Claude shows every change it makes. Beta on paid plans, on web, desktop and mobile.

slides.title: Claude *Whiteboards*
slides.body: Talk through a plan and Claude lays it out as a board with timelines, owners and dates. Several people can work on the same board at once. When you are done, turn it into a doc or a slide deck. Also beta on paid plans.

slides.title: Claude *Meetings*
slides.body: Claude joins a video call as a visible participant, follows along, answers questions in the chat and pulls facts from your connected apps. Notes and action items land in Claude after the call. Beta for Team and Enterprise, starting with Google Meet.

slides.title: The *guardrails*
slides.body: In a meeting, Claude says it is there and posts a notice in the chat. It will not join calls with outside guests unless an admin allows it, and it leaves on its own if an outside guest joins. No separate price for these tools has been reported.

slides.title: What it means *for you*
slides.body: If you pay for Claude, try Sheets on something small: an invoice tracker or a week of bookings. Check every formula and total before you trust it, because it is a beta. On the free plan, nothing changes yet.
